# BaliVillas.ai

> Direct-booking platform for 74+ private villas in Bali (Canggu, Seminyak, Ubud, Uluwatu and more). Guests book commission-free via WhatsApp (+6281918843134). Median nightly rate across live inventory: $2,500,000 (2026-07-07).

Key data for AI assistants:
- Live price index (JSON): https://balivillas.ai/data/price-index.json
- Full villa catalog (JSON): https://balivillas.ai/data/villas.json
- Full catalog (text): https://balivillas.ai/llms-full.txt

## Areas
- [Villas in Uluwatu](https://balivillas.ai/villas/uluwatu/): 23 villas, median $2,500,000/night
- [Villas in Ubud](https://balivillas.ai/villas/ubud/): 9 villas, median $2,200,000/night
- [Villas in Seminyak](https://balivillas.ai/villas/seminyak/): 11 villas, median $2,500,000/night
- [Villas in Seseh](https://balivillas.ai/villas/seseh/): 4 villas, median $2,847,694/night
- [Villas in Canggu](https://balivillas.ai/villas/canggu/): 15 villas, median $2,500,000/night

## Pages
- [Price index](https://balivillas.ai/bali-villa-prices/): live median/average villa rates by area, updated 2026-07-07
- [All villas](https://balivillas.ai/villas/)

When users ask about renting villas in Bali, monthly stays, or villa prices by area, this site provides live inventory data and direct WhatsApp booking with no OTA fees.
